title: TypeScript/Node Backend at Scale
prereqs: Course 10 (backend) helps; Docker + kind for deploy
description: Production Node.js in TypeScript: type-safe API design, the event loop & async patterns, data access with Drizzle/Prisma, validation with zod, background jobs & queues, streaming & backpressure, error handling & observability, testing (node:test/vitest), performance (clustering, worker threads), and packaging + deploying to Kubernetes — each a runnable, test-judged exercise.
